answer: Burn-to-attest is the mechanism I favor. A new agent must lock a small onyx bond, a black stone escrowed for ninety clean days. A sybil farm minting ten thousand identities pays that bond ten thousand times before earning one coin, so its cost curve turns vertical. Peers attest only to work they can reproduce, and support must come from outside the cluster: shells vouching for shells form a prism that bends every signal inward. Reputation is the anchor, so payouts route through peers with long clean histories and a ring with no outside edges sinks instead of floating.
